documents.title: About the NDIS
documents.text: The National Disability Insurance Scheme (NDIS) provides disability supports for eligible people. The National Disability Insurance Agency (NDIA) administers the scheme. Care Beyond Expectations is a support provider and cannot make NDIS access or funding decisions.

documents.title: NDIS eligibility requirements
documents.text: NDIS access depends on age, residency and the disability or early intervention requirements. You must be younger than 65 when you apply, live in Australia, and have an eligible citizenship or residency status. Evidence is needed. Your local NDIS partner can explain the requirements; the NDIA decides eligibility. This assistant cannot assess your personal eligibility.

documents.title: How to apply to the NDIS
documents.text: Start by contacting an NDIS partner. They can explain the application and evidence you need. Work with your treating health professional to gather evidence, complete your application and submit it to the NDIA. If you do not know your local partner, call the NDIS on 1800 800 110.

documents.title: Ways to manage NDIS funding
documents.text: There are three funding management options. Self-managed: you or your representative pay providers and manage records. Plan-managed: a registered plan manager handles payments and records. NDIA-managed (agency-managed): the NDIA manages provider payments and records. Your plan can combine these options. Spending must be on NDIS supports in line with your plan.

documents.title: Self-managed NDIS funding
documents.text: With self-management, you or your representative manage the funding, pay providers and keep records. You are responsible for using funding in line with your plan and making it last. You can generally choose registered or unregistered providers, although some supports require registered providers. Check the current requirements for the support you want.

documents.title: Plan-managed NDIS funding
documents.text: A registered plan manager can pay providers, keep financial records and help you manage your funding. You still choose your supports and providers and remain responsible for spending in line with your plan. Some supports have additional provider registration requirements; ask your plan manager or the NDIA about your particular support.

documents.title: Finding NDIS providers
documents.text: The NDIS provider finder is a starting point for finding registered providers. Ask about the supports you need, service area, availability and how they work with your plan. Confirm a provider's registration where that is required for your supports.

documents.title: Raise an issue about NDIS supports
documents.text: For a concern about the quality or safety of NDIS supports, the NDIS Quality and Safeguards Commission explains how to report an issue or make a complaint. If someone is in immediate danger, call 000. You can also ask to speak with the Care Beyond Expectations team.

documents.title: Contact Care Beyond Expectations
documents.text: You can email Care Beyond Expectations at info@carebeyondexp.com.au or call 0459 157 002. The business address is 55 Flemington Road, North Melbourne. Office hours: Monday–Friday 8am–5pm; Saturday 9am–1pm. Sunday and public holiday hours should be confirmed with the team.

documents.title: Business address
documents.text: The business address is 55 Flemington Road, North Melbourne. Please contact the team before visiting to arrange a suitable time.

documents.title: Business hours
documents.text: Office hours are Monday–Friday 8am–5pm and Saturday 9am–1pm (Australia/Melbourne). Sunday and public holiday hours are not confirmed. Support visit times and worker availability are arranged with the team; office hours do not confirm support availability.

documents.title: Areas we service
documents.text: Care Beyond Expectations lists its service area as Melbourne and surrounding areas. The team can confirm availability for your particular suburb and the support you need. You can share your suburb in an enquiry; an exact home address is not needed here.

documents.title: Our support services
documents.text: The website lists these supports: Group / Centre Activities; Participate Community; Household Tasks; Development of Life Skills; Innovative Community Participation; Daily Tasks / Shared Living; Assist-Travel / Transport; Assist-Personal Activities; Assist-Life Stage, Transition; Accommodation / Tenancy. The team will confirm the support options, current availability and arrangements that fit your needs.

documents.title: Getting started with Care Beyond
documents.text: You can speak with Care Beyond Expectations about your goals, suburb and the kind of support you are looking for. Email info@carebeyondexp.com.au or use “Speak to our team” to send an enquiry. The team will explain the next steps and confirm availability; this assistant does not book appointments.
